notes.title: Sky Mercenaries Update 1.10 has been released!
notes.notes:
- Stage Editor - Create new stages with over 100 different objects
- New Enemies and Bossfights
- Graphics redesign - We recreated over 50% of the inGame graphics
- New upgrade shop and upgrade classes
- Blue moonbeam and new Stage PowerUps
- New difficulty balancing for single player, 2 player and Hardcore Modes
- Optimized performance
- Detailed descriptions and more information about pilots, skills and upgrades.
- New Damage System, armor calc, visible critical hits, weapon / base damage and more
- Optimized user interface, new stats and scorecap
- Player overload glow, new collision system and explosions
- New Steam Cloud Save and Screenshot functions
- New Score system
- Bullet contrast system that changes bullet colors to be visible on every background.
- Optimized menu navigation and gamepad controls
- Stage file import and export

The Steam workshop integration will be part of the 1.11 update, coming soon.
- Steam Workshop - Share and download new stages for Sky Mercenaries
